brand.name: StrategyDynamics
brand.fine: Real runs from a showcase account, with spread and commission. Backtests and forward tests do not promise future results. Trading can lose money.

posts.headline: Every star is|*one of your systems.
posts.sub: Bigger and brighter means it tested better. Tap a star to open it.

callouts.sub: amber stars trade new bars daily

posts.shows: The Home galaxy on the web app: a spiral galaxy where each labelled star is one of the account's trading systems.
posts.angle: Your whole book of systems as a living galaxy, not a list.
facts: 15 systems in the showcase account
Amber stars are forward testing, green deployed, blue tested, violet ideas

posts.headline: It tested 19 ideas|*so I didn't have to.
posts.sub: 293 settings on DAX and Dow. Every line is one of them. Red lines died on data they never saw.
posts.shows: An Edge Finder hunt mid reveal on the web: every setting tested drawn as an equity line, the unseen period shaded on the right, and the survivor named below (GER40 swing stop slow trail).
posts.angle: The app hunts for strategies and only hands back what survived unseen data, and shows the weak unseen result too.
facts: 19 ideas, 293 settings tested, 8 of 19 ideas survived
Markets DAX 40 and Dow 30, 15 minute bars
Best: +33.6% in sample, -1.0% unseen, +32.3% whole window, profit factor 1.44 in sample

posts.headline: It found nothing.|*And it said so.
posts.sub: 19 ideas on gold, 30 minute bars, 5 years. None survived. An honest no beats a curve-fitted yes.
posts.shows: An Edge Finder hunt on gold that ended with no survivor: 107 equity lines all drifting down, labelled "0 of 19 ideas survived".
posts.angle: Most strategy ideas fail after costs. This app tells you so instead of selling you a curve.
facts: Gold, 30 minute bars, 5 years
19 ideas tested, 0 survived, 107 trails drawn
Losing ideas are listed with why they died

posts.headline: Lightning on|*every setting.
posts.sub: It tests the whole grid, then picks the robust setting, not the lucky one.
posts.shows: The Optimise screen on iPhone mid run: a lightning bolt striking a grid of stop size against target size, the robust pick ringed, and the variants' equity lines racing below.
posts.angle: Optimisation you can watch, that picks stable settings over lucky ones.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars
8 of 20 passes done, robust pick so far Sharpe 2.04, +25.3% whole window, -6.4% max drawdown

posts.headline: 20 settings.|*One robust pick.
posts.sub: +45.1% over the whole window with a 4.3% max drawdown. 10 settings failed the unseen data and were dropped.

callouts.sub: the pick, on bars it never saw too

posts.shows: A finished optimisation on the web: the grid of 20 settings with the robust pick locked, and the equity of every variant with the unseen period shaded.
posts.angle: The robust pick is chosen across the whole grid and checked on data it never saw.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars
20 of 20 tested, robust pick Sharpe 3.56 in sample
+45.1% whole window, -4.3% max drawdown, 10 failed unseen

posts.headline: Watch the equity|*draw itself.
posts.sub: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias: +38.9% with real spread and commission. 65 trades, profit factor 2.04.

callouts.sub: the result reveals trade by trade

posts.shows: A backtest result on the web caught mid reveal: the balance line drawing on from the left with a glowing head, under the headline +38.9%, with the unseen period marked on the right.
posts.angle: Results in seconds, with real costs, drawn so you see how the system got there.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars
Net +38.9%, 65 trades, profit factor 2.04, win rate 55%, max equity drawdown 5.9%
In sample +36.9%, unseen +1.4%: graded C, too few unseen trades to judge

posts.headline: The backtest ended.|*The real test began.
posts.sub: Amber is the forward test: bars that did not exist when the system was built.
posts.shows: A system page on the web (DXY Slope Sweep, GBP/USD): one trail in three parts, blue in sample, shaded unseen, then amber forward test ending at Today.
posts.angle: A backtest can be fitted. A forward test on new bars cannot.
facts: DXY Slope Sweep, GBP/USD, 15 minute bars
Whole +38.3%, in sample +28.8%, unseen +7.4%, forward +0.8% so far
103 trades, profit factor 1.59, max drawdown 7.1%

posts.headline: Three systems.|*Trading new bars daily.
posts.sub: +$2,561 since they were seated. Each on its own balance, one summary every morning.
posts.shows: The Forward tests page on the web: "+$2,561, 3 systems on new bars", then each forward test with its own amber line (Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias +1.7% on $100,000).
posts.angle: The forward record decides, and it builds itself every morning without you.
facts: 3 systems forward testing, 3 trades since seating, +$2,561
Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias: +1.7% on $100,000, 1 trade, seated 9 Nov
A forward test ends at 40 trades or 60 days

posts.headline: Six systems.|*One account.
posts.sub: +14% together with a 5.0% max drawdown. Red marks the days they lose together.

callouts.sub: two or more systems down at once

posts.shows: A portfolio test on the web: six systems combined into one account line, +14%, with red sections where two or more systems were losing at once.
posts.angle: Your systems tested as one account, so you see the bad days before they happen together.
facts: 6 systems, May 2026 to November 2026
+14.4% return, 5.0% max drawdown, Sharpe 2.20
42 days losing together

posts.headline: Same systems.|*+42.8% became +58%.
posts.sub: The tune moves sizes, never risk. Sharpe 2.77 to 3.35. Losing days 28 to 21.
posts.shows: The portfolio tune on iPhone: "+58% return, was +42.8%", Sharpe 2.77 to 3.35, 21 days losing together (was 28), with the tuned account line.
posts.angle: One tap tunes the mix of systems as a single account.
facts: Return +58%, was +42.8%
Max drawdown 11.0%, was 9.5%
Sharpe 3.35, was 2.77
Days losing together 21, was 28

posts.headline: Breed your|*best systems.
posts.sub: Two parents, six children. Three survived generation 1. The best scored a profit factor of 1.48.
posts.shows: A breed on iPhone: US30 RSI extreme crossed with GER40 swing structure, a family tree of children (green survived, red died) and the best child's equity line.
posts.angle: Take the systems that work and breed better ones, judged on unseen data.
facts: Parents: US30 RSI extreme reversal x GER40 swing structure target
Generation 1 of 3: 6 tested, 3 survived
Best: GER40 channel break, RSI-free trail, profit factor 1.48, 310 trades

posts.headline: 400 futures|*before real money.
posts.sub: The same 62 trades, reshuffled 400 ways. Typical +48%. Even the worst 5% ended near +27%.
posts.shows: The Monte Carlo stress test on the web: a fan of 400 possible futures from today, the luckiest in green, the typical band in blue, the unluckiest in red, with the worst 5%, typical and best 5% results beneath.
posts.angle: Know the range of outcomes before you put money on a system.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars, 62 trades
400 futures: worst 5% +27%, typical +48%, best 5% +70%, drawdown 9%
Luckiest +83%, unluckiest -1%
2% of futures touched a 10% drawdown

posts.headline: Did it work in|*every period?
posts.sub: Walk forward cuts the record into six periods and judges each on its own. Here: 6 of 6 made money.
posts.shows: The walk forward card on the web: "6 of 6 periods that made money on their own", marked Consistent, the equity line running through six green boxes with each period's result under it.
posts.angle: One good year can carry a bad system. Walk forward shows whether the edge held period by period.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars, 62 trades
6 of 6 periods made money on their own, marked consistent
Six equal stretches of time, no re-tuning

posts.headline: Replay every trade,|*bar by bar.
posts.sub: Entry, stop and target on the real candles. This one ran to its target: +1.91R.
posts.shows: Trade replay on the web: gold 15 minute candles for trade 15 of 65, a long. The green target zone sits above the entry and the red stop zone below it; price climbs through the green zone and closes at the target, +1.91%.
posts.angle: See exactly how each trade happened, instead of trusting a number.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars
Trade 15 of 65: long on 22 Jan 2026, in 4833.79, out 4951.49 at its target
Plays at 1, 4 or 16 times speed
Library candles, fills and exits from the engine run

posts.headline: One system.|*Six ways to run it.
posts.sub: cTrader, MetaTrader 5, MetaTrader 4, TradingView, Python or an agent package. Checked before you see it.
posts.shows: The Deploy sheet on iPhone listing six export targets: cTrader cBot, MetaTrader 5, MetaTrader 4, TradingView Pine Script v6, Python and an agent package.
posts.angle: From a tested system to a running bot on your platform, without writing code.
facts: Six targets: cTrader cBot (C#), MQL5, MQL4, Pine Script v6, Python, agent package
Each export is checked on a worker before you see it, with its parity against the engine
Code export is on the Institutional plan

posts.headline: From plain words|*to a compiled bot.
posts.sub: It shows exactly what was converted. The template owns the trading loop, so the bot trades the rules you tested.
posts.shows: The web Deploy page: "What is converted" for Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, listing entry, filter, exit and risk in plain words, then the exact buy and sell expressions the engine runs.
posts.angle: No drift between what you tested and what the bot trades.
facts: Entry: Asia range break with daily SMA and prior-week close bias agreeing
Stop 6x ATR, target 1.8R, risk 1% a trade, 1 trade a day
4,073 bars of warmup before the first trade

posts.headline: Describe it.|*It builds it.
posts.sub: Type your idea in plain words. Every gene in the helix is a rule it understood.
posts.shows: The Build tab on iPhone: a box to explain a trading idea in plain words, "Build me this", and a DNA helix of the account's systems with genes for entry, filter, session, stop, target and trail.
posts.angle: No code, no block diagrams. Say the strategy and test it.
facts: Three ways in: Build from words, Decode from a file or code, Edge Finder
Genes: entry, filter, session, stop, target, trail

posts.headline: It reads your rules|*back to you.
posts.sub: Before a single test, check it built what you meant. Change anything that is not.
posts.shows: The "How it trades" sheet on iPhone: the system's entry in plain words (close above the 00:00 to 07:00 UTC high, above the daily SMA 40, above last week's close), then direction, days, session, stop 3x ATR, target 3.5R and risk 1%.
posts.angle: The app that tested a different strategy than the one you wrote is the one you leave. This one shows its working.
facts: Asia range break with daily SMA and prior-week close bias
Stop 3x ATR, target 3.5R, risk 1% a trade, 1 trade a day
Session 07:00 to 15:00 UTC

posts.headline: 49 markets.|*Real bars. Real costs.
posts.sub: Gold, silver, indices and FX. Each tested with its own spread and commission.
posts.shows: The Market picker on iPhone: "49 markets in the bar library" with metals (gold, silver, platinum, copper), indices (Nasdaq 100, S&P 500, Dow 30, DAX 40 and more) and FX majors and crosses.
posts.angle: Test on the market you actually trade, with its real costs.
facts: 49 markets in the bar library
Metals, indices, FX majors and crosses

posts.headline: On iPhone.|*And on the web.
posts.sub: One account. Build on the laptop, check the forward test on your phone.
posts.shows: The Home galaxy on the web app in the background and the same Home on iPhone in front.
posts.angle: StrategyDynamics 2.0 is on iPhone and in the browser, with the same account and the same systems.
facts: Same account on iPhone and the web
Pay once, in either place

posts.headline: 140 ways|*to build a strategy.
posts.sub: Say it in plain words. The engine checks every rule before it runs.
posts.shows: A text graphic listing what the engine can build, grouped: indicators, smart money, time, exits, scaling and prop rules.
posts.angle: Whatever you trade, the engine can probably express it.
facts: 140 building blocks
28 indicators, 25 candle patterns, 18 exits
Prop rules as guards: FTMO, FundedNext, The5%ers

posts.headline: It grades its|*own homework.
posts.sub: +19.3%, grade C. Profitable, but under 100 trades a year. It tells you what it cannot prove yet.
posts.shows: A system page on iPhone: Donchian trend with trail, +19.3% whole test return, grade C, with the in sample and unseen parts of its trail.
posts.angle: A grade and a plain reason, so a good-looking number does not fool you.
facts: Donchian trend with trail, gold, 30 minute bars
+19.3%, 82 trades, profit factor 1.99, max drawdown 2.5%
Grade C: tested only, under 100 trades a year

posts.headline: 87 settings tested|*in 63 seconds.
posts.sub: A live hunt on gold. Each setting lands as a trail. 4 of 5 ideas already dead.
posts.shows: A live Edge Finder hunt on iPhone: gold, 30 minute bars, dozens of red trails for dead settings and one green leader at +12.5%, with "Sweeping 87 of 100 settings, 63s".
posts.angle: It does in a minute what takes a trader a weekend.
facts: Gold, 30 minute bars, 5 years
87 of 100 settings in 63 seconds
Leader: Squeeze Then First Break, profit factor 1.32, 73 trades

posts.headline: 300 attempts at|*a prop challenge.
posts.sub: FTMO rules, day by day: 10% target, 10% max loss, 5% daily. 99% passed, typically in 11 days.
posts.shows: The challenge race card on the web: 300 attempts at an FTMO challenge drawn as green lines racing from 0% toward the +10% target line, with the -10% max loss line beneath. 99% passed.
posts.angle: Before paying for a challenge, see how often this system would pass one.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars, 62 trades
300 attempts on FTMO rules: 10% target, 10% max loss, 5% daily loss, 60 trading days
99% passed, 1 failed, 2 still racing
Typically 11 days to pass, 0% hit the daily limit

posts.headline: Take out its|*10 best trades.
posts.sub: Still +21%. If a few lucky winners carried the result, this is where it shows.
posts.shows: The "Without the best trades" card on the web, marked Not luck: bars for the net result with all trades, then without the top 1, 3, 5 and 10 winners.
posts.angle: A system that only works because of two or three big wins is luck. This test removes them and looks again.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars, 62 trades
All trades +49%, profit factor 2.45
Without the top 1: +45%. Top 3: +39%. Top 5: +34%. Top 10: +21%, profit factor 1.64
Marked not luck

posts.headline: Miss 1 trade in 10.|*Still in profit?
posts.sub: 300 runs, each skipping a random tenth of the trades. 300 of 300 stayed in profit.
posts.shows: The "Missed trades, skip 1 in 10" card on the web: 100% still in profit, with a green histogram of where the 300 runs ended.
posts.angle: Real trading misses fills. This shows whether the edge survives when a tenth of the trades never happen.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars, 62 trades
300 runs, each missing a random tenth of the trades
100% still in profit, 300 of 300 runs
Worst 5% +36%, typical +45%, best 5% +51%

posts.headline: A peak its neighbours|*do not back is luck.
posts.sub: Every setting drawn as terrain. Green is ground that holds. Red peaks are marked luck.
posts.shows: The stability terrain on the web: a 3D surface of profit factor over the stop and trail settings. The robust setting is ringed in green with its value, and three red peaks are labelled LUCK.
posts.angle: The best single setting is often a fluke. The terrain shows whether the settings around it hold up too.
facts: Donchian trend with trail, gold, 30 minute bars, 82 trades
Robust pick: stop 3.65, trail 5, profit factor 2.00, neighbours 1.97
3 isolated peaks, a best that its neighbours do not back
25 engine runs on the same bars

posts.headline: Does it work in|*every kind of market?
posts.sub: Quarter by quarter, then by volatility and trend. Here: 5 of 6 quarters made money.
posts.shows: The regime card on the web: "5 of 6 quarters made money", a bar for each quarter's profit, then results in low, mid and high volatility.
posts.angle: An edge that only works in one kind of market stops working when the market changes.
facts: Donchian trend with trail, gold, 30 minute bars, 82 trades
5 of 6 quarters made money
Made the most in up trend: +15.0% on 51 trades. Down trend +3.7% on 32 trades
Low volatility +5.7%, mid +3.9%, high +9.0%

posts.headline: Does the bot trade|*what you tested?
posts.sub: The exported code runs beside the engine on the same bars and costs. Here: 16 of 16 trades the same, to the cent.
posts.shows: The parity card on the web: 100%, same entry, exit and reason as the engine. 16 of 16 trades match to the cent, engine +0.1% and exported code +0.1%.
posts.angle: The usual gap between a backtest and a bot is the code. Parity measures that gap before you run it.
facts: Donchian trend with trail, gold, 30 minute bars, 82 trades
Parity 100%: same entry, exit and reason as the engine
16 of 16 trades to the cent, largest gap on one matched trade $0
Engine +0.1% on 16 trades, exported code +0.1% on 16 trades

posts.headline: Nine stress tests.|*One screen.
posts.sub: Monte Carlo, walk forward, challenge race, best trades, missed trades and more. Run them before money.
posts.shows: The whole Stress screen on the web with its tests complete: the Monte Carlo fan across the top, walk forward at 6 of 6 and the challenge race at 99% beneath, then without the best trades and missed trades.
posts.angle: One place to try to break a system before trusting it.
facts: Gold Asia Box Weekly Bias, gold, 15 minute bars, 62 trades
Nine stress tests on one screen
Monte Carlo worst 5% +27%; walk forward 6 of 6; challenge race 99% passed
Without the top 10 trades +21%; missing 1 trade in 10, 100% still in profit

posts.headline: Was it the system,|*or the news?
posts.sub: Trades held through red news are flagged and totalled. Here: 4 trades, +0.76% between them.
posts.shows: A backtest on the web: a News tile reading +0.76%, held through red news on 4 trades, beside a Breaker note saying the system is profitable in sample but loses on unseen data. Below, the first trade is tagged "Held through USD Fed rate decision".
posts.angle: A result made by one news spike is not an edge. The app shows which trades sat through red news and what they added.
facts: PropDynamics v2, US30, 15 minute bars, 257 trades
4 trades held through red news, +0.76% between them
Trade 1 hit its target, +1.38%, held through the USD Fed rate decision
Breaker: profitable in sample, loses on unseen data

posts.headline: Stress said no.|*Better now than live.
posts.sub: Worst 5% of futures ended at -9%. 70% touched a 10% drawdown. Found before any money went on it.
posts.shows: The Monte Carlo stress test on the web for a weaker system: the fan of 400 futures spreads wide, the unluckiest line in red falls well below zero, and the worst 5% reads -9%.
posts.angle: The point of a stress test is to be told no. This system looked fine on its backtest and did not survive.
facts: PropDynamics v2, US30, 15 minute bars, 257 trades
400 futures: worst 5% -9%, typical +26%, best 5% +56%, drawdown 25%
70% of futures touched a 10% drawdown

posts.headline: Start with|*a sentence.
posts.sub: Describe it, drop in a file, or let it discover one. You read the rules back before anything is saved or run.
posts.shows: The Build page on the web: a box that says "Explain your trading idea here" with Describe, From a file and Discover tabs and a green "Build me this" button. Beneath it, the account's systems drawn as strands of genes.
posts.angle: No code and no form to fill. Say the idea the way you would say it to another trader.
facts: Three ways in: describe, from a file, discover
The market and the bars are read from the idea
You read the rules back before anything is saved or run

posts.feature: Edge Finder: set up a hunt
posts.headline: 18 styles.|*Breed up to four.
posts.sub: Pick a market and a timeframe. Edge Finder breeds the ideas, tests them on real bars with real costs, and keeps what survives.
posts.shows: The Edge Finder setup on the web: 18 style buttons with Trend, Breakout, Mean reversion and Sweep chosen, 4 of 4, and the timeframe row beneath with 30M selected.
posts.angle: You choose the kind of idea. It does the breeding and the testing.
facts: 18 styles to breed from, up to 4 a hunt
Styles include trend, breakout, mean reversion, sweep, smart money, grid
Timeframes from 1 minute to 1 day
